entities.summary: Nikolay Evgenievich Lanceray was a Russian architect, preservationist, illustrator of books and historian of neoclassical art, biographer of Charles Cameron, Vincenzo Brenna and Andreyan Zakharov. Lanceray was associated with Mir Iskusstva art circle and was a proponent of Russian neoclassical revival school. Nikolay Lanceray was a architects & engineers from Saint Petersburg (1879-04-26, Saint Petersburg–1942-05-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
